TRIGGERED_ABILITY.TARGET_DEFINITION: local filter = ClearFilter() filter:Add(FE_CONTROLLER, OP_IS, EffectController() ) filter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE )
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local targetDC = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0) for i=0,(2-1) do local target_creature = targetDC:Get_CardPtr(i) local number = targetDC:Get_Assignment(i) if ( target_creature ~= nil ) then target_creature:AddCounters( MTG():PlusOnePlusOneCounters() , number ) end end
